summary: Make production promotion consume complete staging evidence instead of debugging release automation live.
details: The deployment-reliability series defines, implements, audits, and tests separate product-release and personal-promotion workflows. Product release publishes the exact CI-validated image by immutable digest with mandatory SBOM and vulnerability evidence; it never rebuilds between validation and publication. Personal deployment selects one published digest, exercises the exact images through disposable production-equivalent staging, binds one owner approval to the complete receipt plus fixed operator and root-runner hashes, and promotes through an evidence-verifying wrapper that can recover from a completed transaction receipt without repeating production mutation. Root executes uploaded staging, scaffold, and maintenance payloads only after copying and revalidating them in root-owned transaction directories. Cloudflared is the sole Menhir ingress authority and its exact container, image, Compose, and network identity is checked for staging non-interference. App-only and security-config use bounded root transactions with automatic rollback; maintenance retains the full backup/rehearsal path. Every successful promotion binds the exact root transaction receipt, runner digest, wrapper digests, elapsed time, and before/after database and ingress identities.
operator_impact: Use release_flow.py to prepare, finalize, and publish the product release. For this owner's instance, use personal_deploy.py rehearse, approve, and promote; review the release notes and staging receipt before the one bound approval. App-only has a five-minute target, security-config has a dedicated ten-minute config/application lane, and database, key-rotation, host, or topology changes mechanically escalate to maintenance.
